name: local-ops
tagline: macOS service dashboard with one-click start and live tracing
description: local-ops is a zero-dependency Python dashboard for macOS services and batch tasks: one-click start, real-time monitoring, and log and process tracing from a clean web UI. It positions itself as an open-source alternative to the closed macOS service managers. If you run several local services and are tired of launchctl spelunking, this gives them a single pane of glass.
highlights: One-click start and stop for local macOS services
Real-time monitoring with log and process tracing
Open-source alternative to macOS service managers
curatorNote: Local services always end up as a pile of launchctl commands and tmux windows. A zero-dependency dashboard that centralizes start, monitoring, and tracing is quietly useful for every macOS power user.
